title: Quick Pro GR:ONE product card
notes: Opened exact-model product card states maximum tire size at or below 700C x 45C and lists an M frame at 919 g, fork at 459 g and seatpost at 169 g, each with a plus-or-minus 5% tolerance. The card does not identify the GRX Di2 factory build or a complete-bike weight. Its M-frame figure conflicts with the current global official frameset page's 879 g claim, so the existing exact-page value is retained until generation and weighing scope are reconciled.
